$comment: Known QuotaFpc deployments + the provenance record consumed by scripts/verify-lineage.ts. mainnet.classId is the only class id ever checked against a live chain (Aztec 5.0.1). compiled[<aztecVersion>] entries are class ids this repo compiled and reviewed for later Aztec versions: local pins, not proof of any deployment. verify:lineage asserts the compiled artifact matches the anchor for the root config.aztecVersion. currentAztecVersion is the Aztec version this package build targets (swept by bump-aztec.ts, asserted equal to config.aztecVersion by verify:lineage): the deploy guard accepts only its anchor.

mainnet.name: Dark Forest quota paymaster (reference deployment — NOT this package's to operate)

verification.method: read-only node_getContract via https://aztec-mainnet.drpc.org (scripts/chain-verify.ts); currentContractClassId AND originalContractClassId both matched the locally compiled artifact

mainnet.warning: Fee juice is protocol-non-transferable: funding this instance is an IRREVERSIBLE donation to Dark Forest. Deploy your own paymaster instead.
